description: Traverse a known site when one page is not enough and you need multiple relevant docs pages, posts, or thread items. Start from a concrete site URL; if you need to discover the site first, use smartsearch, and if you only need one direct URL, use smartfetch. Add `output_dir` when you want the crawl written to a local Markdown folder instead of returned only as a ranked summary; successful exports embed `resource_handle_manifest` in structuredContent with file:// handles for exported documents and metadata files. For LinkedIn profile URLs this is best-effort recent public post discovery, not full archive pagination. If smart-web returns reproducible incorrect or misleading output, open a GitHub issue on jojo-labs/smart-web with the exact input, arguments, observed output, expected behavior, and version. Skip obvious transient network/auth/rate-limit failures unless smart-web misclassified them.

context_mode.description: Coarse alias/backcompat fallback when no numeric budget control is supplied.

exclude_patterns.description: Optional regex or substring patterns for URLs to skip

follow_pagination.description: Follow next or more-style pagination links during exploration

format.description: Text rendering format for the human-readable content. Defaults to compact rendered text while structuredContent carries the projected result; use json only when the host needs JSON duplicated in content[0].text.

headroom_tokens.description: Null means absent. Approximate remaining host context tokens. Uses compact/balanced fallback only; request full explicitly with output_budget or preferred_budget_chars.

include_patterns.description: Optional regex or substring patterns for URLs to keep

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked results to return. For LinkedIn profile URLs this acts like a best-effort recent public post count.

max_depth.description: Maximum recursive depth from the starting URL. Export mode can use deeper values than the summary crawl path.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to visit. In export mode this is the docs crawl budget; otherwise smartcrawl still behaves like an exploration-oriented crawl.

mode.description: Traversal hint for boards, docs sites, or automatic detection

output_budget.description: Explicit summary output projection. Defaults to compact; output_dir export mode still returns resource handles rather than inline documents.

output_dir.description: Optional local directory where a docs-style crawl should be exported as Markdown files. When omitted, smartcrawl returns only a ranked crawl summary. Successful exports embed resource_handle_manifest in structuredContent with file:// handles for exported documents, README summary, crawl manifest, and resource-handle JSON.

preferred_budget_chars.description: Null means absent. Preferred host/RPC budget hint. Projects summary structuredContent and text to compact/balanced/full.

query.description: Optional topic filter used to rank crawl results

same_origin_only.description: Restrict traversal to the starting origin while still surfacing external item links

scroll_steps.description: How many scroll attempts to use for scroll-driven pages

url.description: Starting site or docs URL to explore. Use this when you need multiple pages from one site, not a single direct URL fetch.

title: Smart Crawl
